| L02 | *If I …ed, I'd …* |  | unreal condition |

| L02 | *the thing I …* |  | reduced clause |

| L03 | repeat the **phrase**, not the word, with the beat |  | the sentence sounded flat |
| L03 | carry on; fix it on the next occurrence |  | a weak form came out strong |
| L03 | repair immediately — it changes meaning |  | you dropped a *'ll* or *'d* |
| L03 | add a short falling tag: *…anyway.* ↘️ |  | your turn ended on a rise |
| L03 | *What I mean is…* and restart the clause |  | you are losing the thread |

| L04 | *I see it differently, actually. · I'm not sure I'd go that far.* |  | **Disagree softly** |
| L04 | *That's a fair point, but I'd still say… · Fair enough — although…* |  | **Concede then hold** |
